trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions — verified successful.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.
